_rules: Agents may change only passes, evidence and next_action. Humans add, edit, reorder or remove items.

items.title: Example: user can sign up with email
done_when: ./init.sh then POST /signup with a new email returns 201 and the user appears in GET /users
a duplicate email returns 409 with a readable message

items.title: Example: password reset email is sent
done_when: a reset request writes one message to the dev mail outbox
